description: This class defines a StringObject used in the OFBiz minilang framework. It encapsulates the logic for creating a String argument, optionally combining a CDATA value and a specified value, to be passed to a method call within the mini-language script.

classes.name: StringObject
classes.description: A class that models a String object used in the mini-language, capable of expanding and concatenating string components for method arguments.

methods.name: StringObject
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the StringObject with XML element data and a reference to the parent SimpleMethod.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Returns the expanded string value, concatenating the 'value' attribute and the CDATA content after expansion.

methods.name: getTypeClass
methods.description: Returns the Class object representing the String type.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the string 'java.lang.String' indicating the type of object produced.
